scope: item 5 only; statistics of the retained loaded-surface counterfactual, not the fixed depth profile
keeps: Accepted 32-site full-loading graph, coefficient bytes, optical loss, time step, burn-in, observation window, source energies/shapes/radial weights and per-D normalization
Identical thermal innovations and packet phase in the linear and nonlinear branches; ambient and packet scenarios remain paired by phase identifier
Whole threshold distributions, occupancy and upward crossing counts; current scaling is physical Palm weighting, not faster artificial arrivals
changes: Draw circular complex Gaussian variates in exact source-site order, with independent per-phase counter-based streams; apply the positive covariance root constructed with a fixed exact Fourier basis
Use 64 phases for every retained source scenario and focus additional phases only on 2.5-keV eta=0.1, preserving explicit phase/scenario identities
Separate inward projected kinetic energy from a common velocity-clock diagnostic and separate common harmonic/action scores from each branch's own local energy
Report phase-cluster uncertainty and simultaneous finite-sample category intervals, including nonzero unresolved bounds for zero observed rare responses
drops: Any change to the seed, contact replay, source stopping, deterministic transport or profile
Any inference of enhancement from one unmatched maximum, empirical zero standard error, or an eigensolver-dependent random draw

target.quantity: paired nonlinear-minus-linear arrival-centered Palm inward-maximum excess per D per second

stopping: After 128 focused phases, stop if the simultaneous 95% finite-category interval excludes zero or its half-width is at most 1000 per D/s; otherwise use the remaining focused phases to 256 and report the achieved interval without promoting an unresolved sign. This absolute resolution bounds the contribution against a separately reported ambient-window rate; it is not a relative-precision claim about a near-zero excess.
numerical_claim: Fixed variate assignment removes solver-mode ambiguity. Floating-point evolution can differ across libraries; no cross-host bitwise equality is claimed before an observed cross-host comparison.
